## Purpose

Search engine optimization: technical (crawlability/indexability), on-page (meta, headings, structure), structured data (JSON-LD/schema), mobile-friendliness, perf signals. Trigger: "optimize for SEO", "improve search ranking", "fix meta tags". 30+ requirements from Lighthouse.
